text: Scottish First Minister Humza Yousaf, who has been extremely pro-Palestine, refuses to mention Jews or Jewish people when giving a video address about the Holocaust.
UN Secretary General releases video statement on Holocaust Memorial Day but fails to mention Jewish people.

The gradual erasure of Jewish heritage and history on the English Wikipedia continues. An editor is now systematically redefining many inscriptions from Jerusalem dating from the biblical period as primarily “Canaanite inscriptions.” He even removed the word “Hebrew” altogether from a Paleo-Hebrew seal found in the City of David.

Anne Frank and Primo Levi are among the most powerful symbols of Holocaust remembrance. A mural in Milan depicting the two under a sky of Stars of David, accompanied by the message “Memory Is No Longer Enough,” was vandalized with the antisemitic slogan “Zionist Nazi Settlers,” while the original message was erased.

Anti-Israel protesters in Sweden are carrying signs mimicking the 'Arbeit Macht Frei' sign from the Auschwitz death camp. Pro-Palestinians staged a demonstration in central Stockholm featuring a mock Auschwitz entrance gate with the word 'Gaza' replacing the Nazi slogan 'Arbeit Macht Frei,' drawing widespread condemnation from Jewish leaders and Holocaust experts. The protest, organized by Palestina Demonstration Stockholm, called for the release of Palestinian “doctor” Dr. Hussam Abu Safiya, whom Israel says is a Hamas colonel. The demonstration included a man dressed as Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu with fake blood covering his head and clothes, portraying him beneath the mock Auschwitz gate alongside depictions of Gazan mothers and babies. The Netanyahu figure was also shown waving a wad of cash.
The Los Angeles statue of Chiune Sugihara, who rescued Jews during the Holocaust, was defaced with red paint.
Rachel Moiselle reports protests against Israeli attendees at a Google Ireland conference, including a placard displaying Hitler's face meshed with Benjamin Netanyahu.
Div calls the ending of Schindler’s List explicitly Zionist, while Luc Bernard objects to treating the Holocaust film as Zionist propaganda.
Michael Elgort and Shlomit Lir demonstrate that English Wikipedia editors removed Hebrew and Eretz Yisrael terminology from descriptions of Jewish history.
Shlomit Lir documents English Wikipedia edits replacing Hebrew terminology in descriptions of inscriptions from biblical Jerusalem with Canaanite terminology.
An account uses a 1722 book titled Palestine to imply Jews’ country was invented by the Rothschilds; a response points to ancient Judean history predating that book.
The satirical musical Slam Frank depicts a play within a play in which Anne Frank alerts the Nazis to prevent Israel’s creation.

California’s education department finds Oakland Unified discriminated against Jewish students: 1) Passed out Middle East maps that ERASED ISRAEL, again, and again, and AGAIN, 2) Flew a Palestinian flag for a month after October 7, but not an Israeli one, and 3) Organized a schoolwide “teach-in” on Gaza that didn’t include a single Jewish or Israeli perspective.
The Young Turks host Cenk Uygur claims Muslims and Jews got along well in the Middle East until 1948; a community note points out his erasure of discriminatory dhimmi laws and anti-Jewish massacres.
Amnesty UK says no modern conflict has killed more journalists than Gaza and lists only 69 for World War II; Aizenberg counters with Yad Vashem’s Holocaust records of 1,425 journalists.
“FREE GAZA” is scratched into Lyon’s memorial to Jewish children murdered in the Holocaust, using the memory of murdered Jews as a target for antizionist vandalism.

Amnesty UK claims Gaza has the highest journalist death toll of any modern conflict and lists just 69 for World War II. It erases 1,425 journalist documented by Yad Vashem killed in the Holocaust. There was a massive Yiddish press in Europe at the time erased by the Nazis.

The Young Turks host Cenk Uygur says Muslims and Jews got along until 1948. Arab mobs massacred 67 Jews in Hebron in August 1929, destroying the city’s longstanding Jewish community nearly two decades before Israel’s independence.
